title: Account access, overdraft and funds-availability decision model
workflow: Validate customer mandate, account status and debit action
Read authoritative ledger checkpoint and effective holds
Include approved overdraft/facility terms only if binding
Calculate available amount using exact currency precision
Deny/hold when data stale, disputed or insufficient
Return decision version to posting service for atomic validation
invariants: Displayed availability is not an authoritative money balance
Unapproved overdraft cannot fund an instruction
Credit facility does not imply banking account permission
Concurrent funds requests require reservation/atomicity protection
Cross-currency balances require approved conversion method
A denied decision must not create accounting entries
planned_tests: Parallel debits cannot overspend approved funds
Stale snapshot must revalidate before commit
Closed account unavailable despite positive balance
approval_gate: CFO-approved funds policy, authorized loan facility semantics and concurrent posting tests.
